title: 第一卷 第10章 铭刻 无限子弹
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

今天天气温和，那是不是还有天气恶劣的时候？

看了一下交易平台。

自己挂上去的橡胶，只交易出去了五十块！

也算正常，毕竟很多人，并没有多余的木板，能够升级到一级木屋，已经是极限了。

能换出去这五十块，都已经算是那些天赋和运气都还不错的。

就算是这样，也已经有了一千块的木板，加上原本剩下的木板。

秦龙现在的木板数量已经达到了一千一百一十块了。

将剩余的五十块橡胶给改了个价格！

今天，一块橡胶交易五十块木板，或者别的好东西！

目前来说，这个橡胶，在这个区域里面，也就自己有大量的货。

别人就算找到，那也就是够自己升级的。

木屋升级！

下一刻，木屋开始朝着三级木屋升级！

空间再一次变大。

除了简易制作台，还出现了一间独立的空间。

里面有马桶，上面还有花洒。

这是一个卫生间！

不错，卫生间这个东西，也是非常重要。

有吃就得拉。

晚上又不能出门，总不能拉在房间地板吧。

尝试了一下，并没有什么水，连马桶之中也没有水。

想要使用，必须要在上面的水箱里面自己加水。

洗澡还是冲马桶，用的都是上面水箱里面的水。

需要自己加水。

看了看昨天从河滩里弄的水，秦龙往里面倒进去了几桶。

自己的床变得更大了一点，结实了一点。

而在一边的墙壁之上，还出现了一个窗户！

窗户是玻璃制作的。

本来是普通的玻璃，现在变成了木屋窗户以后，这玻璃结实无比。

这或许就是规则性的力量。

这玻璃还是单向了，只能从里面看到外面。

从外面是看不到里面任何的东西。

但不妨碍阳光进入。

这下好了，自己可以观察外面的情况了。

或许夜晚还能够观察一下，黑夜的生物到底是什么东西。

控制握把也是更加方便，前面的观察小孔，变成了一个单向的玻璃观察面。

能够看到更加宽广的视野。

木屋的移动速度也变快了不少。

这还不算晚。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The weather is mild today. Is there any chance of bad weather?

Take a look at the trading platform.

The rubber I hung up by myself only cost fifty yuan!

It's normal. After all, many people don't have extra wooden boards. The ability to upgrade to a first-class wooden house is already the limit.

The fifty yuan that can be exchanged are considered to be those who have good talent and luck.

Even so, there are already a thousand wooden boards, plus the remaining wooden boards.

Qin Long's current number of wooden boards has reached 1,110.

Changed the price of the remaining fifty pieces of rubber!

Today, one piece of rubber is traded for fifty planks of wood, or something good!

At present, this rubber only has a large amount of goods in this area.

Even if others find it, it will only be enough for them to upgrade.

Log cabin upgrade!

The next moment, the wooden house began to upgrade to a third-level wooden house!

The space becomes larger again.

In addition to the simple production table, an independent space also appeared.

There is a toilet inside and a shower above.

This is a bathroom!

Yes, the bathroom is also very important.

You have to poop if you want to eat.

Since you can't go out at night, you can't just hang it on the floor of your room.

I tried it, but there was no water, not even in the toilet.

To use it, you must add water to the water tank above.

When taking a shower or flushing the toilet, water from the tank above is used.

You need to add water yourself.

After looking at the water he got from the river beach yesterday, Qin Long poured a few buckets into it.

My bed became a little bigger and a little firmer.

And on one side of the wall, a window appeared!

The windows are made of glass.

It was originally ordinary glass, but now it has become a wooden house window. This glass is extremely strong.

This may be the power of regularity.

The glass is still one-way, so you can only see the outside from the inside.

Nothing inside can be seen from the outside.

But it does not prevent sunlight from entering.

Now it's good, I can observe the situation outside.

Maybe you can also observe at night what the creatures of the night are.

The control handle is also more convenient, and the observation hole on the front becomes a one-way glass observation surface.

Able to see a wider field of view.

The movement speed of the wooden house has also become much faster.

It's not too late.
